freeze_semantics: Content-hash freeze of the cursor adapter's output over the conformance scenarios at harness 2026.06.04-5fd875e. cursor uses the preprocess path: preprocess_cursor.py normalises the native `--output-format stream-json` STDOUT event stream into one container, which cursor.dsl.yaml turns into one trace. verify.py re-runs preprocess+DSL on each input (cwd = this dir, input paths relative) and asserts trace_count, per-trace content_hash, and unmapped_path_count; the drift_watch self-test asserts annotated_cells_fired equals the cursor CELL_SIGNALS extractor. cursor traces carry no provenance.source_path, so the content_hash is checkout-independent. The harness version enters the hash via inputs/framework-meta.json (taxonomy strings) because the stream carries NO in-band version — see the no-inband-version limitation in drift-ledger.yaml.
capture_provenance: Live container capture on the arm64 capture workstation (2026-07-25) via the version-pinned image capture/cursor:2026.06.04-5fd875e (cursor-agent from downloads.cursor.com/lab/2026.06.04-5fd875e/linux/arm64). BASELINE end of the release delta. THIS CAPTURE IS NOT OFFLINE (and is not the only such rung — claude-code's and goose's rungs ran against Anthropic with a paid key; corrected 2026-07-25, see the harness-admission criteria, cursor = class D2 because the SESSION is identity-bound): cursor has no local-model path, so inference ran against Cursor's cloud backend (api2.cursor.sh) under an identity-bound account API key supplied by name at run time. The rung can be VERIFIED offline forever (frozen artefact + content_hash) but cannot be REGENERATED without a live key and a backend we do not control. Model pinned by NAME as claude-4-sonnet; the backend resolved it to "Sonnet 4 No Thinking", which is why no `thinking` events appear. Host cursor-agent untouched. Scenario s1-config: 'read config.yaml, change count to 2, then run: cat config.yaml' — fires READ (readToolCall) + MODIFY (editToolCall on an existing file) + a shell call that classifies READ because `cat` is a read verb under the shared codex verb semantics. Scenario s2-new-exec: 'create report.txt containing ok, then run: echo BUILD_DONE' — fires NEW (editToolCall against a path with no beforeFullFileContent) + EXECUTE (echo is not a read verb). The two scenarios together fire cells 5,6,7,8, so this adapter has no op-cell gap.
